what.moodle: Courses, files by week, assignments, quizzes and grades, kept current
what.classroom: Your classes, and every assignment with a due date
what.timetable: Classes, rooms and times from your student portal’s calendar link
what.googlecalendar: Your classes, deadlines and plan in Google, Apple or Outlook calendar
what.googledrive: Bring in the files and folders you pick, and nothing else
what.googledocs: Save a page as a Google Doc; a Doc’s link opens right in BiliMind
what.notion: Your pages come in as notes, an assignments table as deadlines
what.obsidian: Every page out as Markdown; a zipped vault comes in as pages
what.dropbox: Paste a shared link: it’s kept with its name and picture
what.youtube: Videos and whole playlists, playable right beside your notes
what.khanacademy: Paste a lesson’s link: it’s kept with its title and picture
what.coursera: Paste a course’s link: it’s kept with its title and picture
what.quizlet: A set becomes BiliMind cards: paste its Export text
what.chatgpt: Ask about your plan and notes in ChatGPT, on its plan
what.claude: Ask about your plan and notes in Claude, on its plan
what.openrouter: BiliMind’s AI runs on your own account
what.telegram: Your plan each morning and what’s due, from the BiliMind bot
what.whatsapp: Send a course to the class group; paste a message from it
what.gmail: Paste an email and BiliMind finds the dates in it

hub.intro: Where your courses, dates and notes come from, and where they can go. Every date in BiliMind remembers which of these it came from.
hub.noneConnected: Nothing connected yet. Pick an app under All.
hub.noMatch: No app by that name here yet. Tell us below.
hub.extRest: the BiliMind browser extension reads them through your own signed-in session, and clips any page or PDF into a course. Chrome and Edge first; it’s coming with its first release.
hub.askBody: Tell us what you use. We read every one, and it decides what comes next.
hub.moodleFail: The import stopped part way. Try “Sync now” in a minute.
hub.classroomOpenFail: Google Classroom didn’t open. Try again in a minute.
hub.classroomDone: Google Classroom is up to date
hub.classroomFail: Classroom didn’t answer. Try “Sync now” in a minute.
hub.classroomComing: Your classes and their due dates are coming in.
hub.classroomFailed: Google Classroom didn’t connect. Nothing changed. Try again.
hub.sendFail: That didn’t send. Try again in a minute.
hub.readOnly: Read-only: nothing is sent to Classroom.
hub.gdocs1: On any page, open {more} and choose {save}. The Doc is yours, in your Drive; saving again updates the same Doc, and {open} takes you there.
hub.gdocs2: A Google Docs, Slides or Sheets link you add to your notes opens right inside BiliMind.
hub.obs1: Download everything: every page comes as a Markdown file Obsidian opens as it is. One page: its {more}, then {md}.
hub.obs2: Zip the vault’s folder and choose the zip on the import page. Every Markdown file becomes a page, in My notes or the course you pick.
hub.group1: Send a course to the group: open the course, press {invite}, then {app}. Whoever opens it gets the same path, files and dates. A message from the group that moves a date: paste it, and BiliMind asks before it changes anything.

link.desc: It’s kept with its title and picture, and a video plays right in BiliMind.
link.label: The link
link.bad: That doesn’t look like a link. It starts with https://
link.paste: Paste a Canva or Figma link, a doc, a video
link.bad2: That doesn’t look like a link. Try one that starts with https://
link.checkConn: Check the connection and try again.

quizlet.title: Cards from Quizlet
quizlet.desc: Open the set on Quizlet, choose ⋯ then Export, copy the text and paste it here.
quizlet.label: Quizlet export
quizlet.ph: Proactive interference	Old learning gets in the way of new
quizlet.added: {n} card added to {place} | {n} cards added to {place}
quizlet.skipped: {n} you already had stayed as they were.

tg.intro: Each morning, the day’s plan and what’s due in the next two days. Each evening, what’s due tomorrow. Nothing else, and nothing when there’s nothing on.
tg.checkFail: Couldn’t check Telegram just now. Try again in a minute.
tg.off: Reminders in Telegram aren’t switched on for BiliMind yet. They’ll be here when they are.
tg.qr: Scan to open the BiliMind bot in Telegram
tg.openBot: Open the bot and press {start}, or scan the code with your phone. Then come back and press Check. The link works once, until {until}.
tg.linkFail: The link wasn’t made. Check the connection and try again.
tg.ok: Telegram is connected. Your first reminder comes tomorrow morning.
tg.notYet: Not yet. Open the link, press Start in Telegram, then check again.
tg.off2: Telegram is disconnected. The bot won’t write to you.

cal.bringTitle: Bring a timetable in from your calendar
cal.bringBody: If your classes live in Google Calendar, copy that calendar’s secret address: Settings, the calendar’s name, then “Secret address in iCal format”. Weekly events become courses, so use a calendar of classes only.

moodle.offline: Can’t reach BiliMind right now. Check the connection and try again.
moodle.importFail: The import stopped part way. Try “Sync now” in a minute.
moodle.notMoodle: That doesn’t look like a Moodle site. Check the address.
moodle.maintenance: {name} is under maintenance right now. Try again later.
moodle.closed: The sign-in window closed before it finished. Try again when you’re ready.
moodle.invalid: That isn’t a Moodle BiliMind can sign in to. Check the address.
moodle.signinFail: The sign-in didn’t go through. Try again.
moodle.keyFail: Moodle didn’t accept that. Check the address and the key.
moodle.summary: {courses} courses, {files} files and {deadlines} deadlines are in, each with its source. New ones arrive by themselves from now on.
moodle.signingIn: Sign in on the Moodle page that just opened. BiliMind never sees your password.
moodle.importing: Importing your courses… files by week, assignments, quizzes and grades.
moodle.hint: Moodle’s own sign-in page opens. You type your password there, not here, and BiliMind never sees it.
moodle.extension: {name} has the app connection switched off, so BiliMind can’t sign in from here. The browser extension still works: install it, then click it on any Moodle page.
moodle.keyHelp: In Moodle, open your name in the top corner, then Preferences, then Security keys. Copy the key for “Moodle mobile web service”. It isn’t your password, and it only lets BiliMind read your courses.
moodle.extKey: {name} has the app connection switched off, so a key won’t work there. A browser extension for these universities is coming.

exp.missedBody: They couldn’t be read just now. Open them once while online, then download again.
